patent.title: Stacked module with an integrated fluid channel (fictional example)

independent.text_verbatim: A stacked module comprising: a substrate having a first surface; and a heat spreader thermally coupled to the first surface, the heat spreader defining a fluid channel.

elements.text_verbatim: a substrate having a first surface;
a heat spreader thermally coupled to the first surface, the heat spreader defining a fluid channel.

dependents.text_verbatim: The stacked module of claim 1, wherein the fluid channel has a hydraulic diameter of 0.08 mm.

applicant_interest.signal: The interest is staked on placing the coolant path inside the spreader body rather than in a separate part; the channel dimensions sit in the dependent claims, not in claim 1.

figures.caption_quote: FIG. 2 is a section view of the heat spreader.

items.statement_en: Forming the channel inside the spreader body points at removing a cold plate rather than adding one: the design attacks heat by deleting an interface, not by stacking another part.
evidence_quotes: the channel is formed within the spreader so that a separate cold plate is not required

drop_signal.reason: 권리 관심이 한 구성에 뚜렷하고, 효과 주장이 명세서 문언으로 존재해 '안도감 착지'가 물증으로 가능함.
